title: On track of my projects!
body: Since I have discovered the project planning feature in Strides, I'm really motivated work toward my goal. This is because Strides showed me if I'm behind schedule or when my progress bar is all green and right on track! I'm amazed how fast I'm able to finish my project with small consistent progress!

body: The only app that has all the options I needed! I tried the free version first, but the paid version is worth it if you really want to make serious progress with your habits. The tracking part is addictive😊.

title: Nice app
body: This is a really nice app, it motivates me to do my chores, to stretch... you can add any type of thing you want to keep a streak to. It also has a fun word if you get a streak, or a “perfect day”. You can also set notes with a note, designed by yourself.

title: Avoid at all cost
body:
Nice in theory, but has been very buggy. They removed the export functionality AND added cloud sync without notice. Considering the personal nature habits might have, the latter is absolutely unacceptable.

I've rarely been this disappointed in what initially seemed a promising app with a nice interface.
